conclusions: The November 10 server-side root cause cannot be established from the retained Vercel logs because the historical query is outside the current one-hour retention.
No current model_timeout or provider-request records were found in the queried retained window. This cannot establish resolution of previously reported timeouts.
Archived transport failure and model_timeout are distinct evidence categories; neither should be used as proof of the other.
Existing later synthetic runs completed model readings beyond 60 seconds. They do not establish a production success rate or explain the earlier stream closure.
